items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I knew of the things that had been said about him

ctx.x: and I thought he was a perfect gentleman. I knew of the things that had been said about him but he --
Yeah. He was a hard leader, and then the "Ray" (phonetic) stories, and then of course, the eccentric stories which they all tell on him. The strange things, the absent-mindedness.
